SNAudioFileAnalyzer.doc: An analyzer that runs sound classification requests on an audio file.

SNAudioStreamAnalyzer.doc: An object you create to analyze a stream of audio data and provide the results to your app.

SNClassification.doc: A type that pairs a sound classifier’s prediction with its confidence in that prediction.

SNClassificationResult.doc: A result that contains the highest-ranking classifications in a time range.

SNClassifySoundRequest.doc: A request that classifies sound using a Core ML model.

SNTimeDurationConstraint.doc: Defines the time duration windows the request’s underlying sound classifier accepts with a range, or an array, of durations.

SNRequest.doc: A protocol that represents sound analysis requests.

SNResult.doc: A protocol that represents sound analysis results.

SNResultsObserving.doc: The interface your app implements to receive the results of an analysis request.

SNErrorCode.doc: The enumerated error codes that the Sound Analysis framework produces.

SNTimeDurationConstraintType.doc: Defines the types a time duration constraint uses.

SNTimeDurationConstraintTypeEnumerated.doc: A constraint type that uses an array of time durations to define what a request’s underlying sound classifier accepts.

SNTimeDurationConstraintTypeRange.doc: A constraint type that uses a time duration range to define what a request’s underlying sound classifier accepts.

-addRequest:withObserver:error:.doc: Adds a new analysis request to the audio file analyzer.

-cancelAnalysis.doc: Cancels all the asynchronous sound analysis requests the analyzer is currently processing.

-initWithURL:error:.doc: Creates a new audio file analyzer.

-removeAllRequests.doc: Removes all the sound analysis requests from the audio file analyzer.

-removeRequest:.doc: Removes an existing request from the audio file analyzer.

-addRequest:withObserver:error:.doc: Adds a new analysis request to the audio stream analyzer.

-analyzeAudioBuffer:atAudioFramePosition.doc: Adds a new audio buffer to the analyzer’s larger stream buffer.

-completeAnalysis.doc: Notifies the analyzer when it receives the final audio buffer.

-initWithFormat:.doc: Creates a new audio stream analyzer.

-removeAllRequests.doc: Removes all the sound analysis requests from the audio stream analyzer.

-removeRequest:.doc: Removes an existing request from the audio stream analyzer.

-classificationForIdentifier:.doc: Returns the classification for an identifier.

-initWithClassifierIdentifier:error:.doc: Creates a request that uses the framework’s built-in sound classification model.

-initWithMLModel:error:.doc: Creates a request that uses a custom sound classification model.

confidence.doc: The confidence value the model has in its prediction.

identifier.doc: A prediction label that’s one of the classifications a sound classifier’s underlying model defines.

classifications.doc: A sorted array of the request’s top classification candidates.

timeRange.doc: The time span that corresponds to the result’s classifications.

knownClassifications.doc: A string array that contains every prediction label in the request’s underlying sound classifier model.

overlapFactor.doc: The amount of overlap between successive analysis windows when the model operates on a fixed-size audio block.

windowDuration.doc: The duration of the audio buffer the request sends to the underlying sound classifier for each prediction.

windowDurationConstraint.doc: A range or list of sound duration times the request’s underlying sound classifier supports.
